name: Franz Ferdinand

whyMatters.en: Glasgow four-piece formed in 2002. Franz Ferdinand (2004, Domino) put angular post-punk guitar and disco-leaning bass on UK/US indie charts; Take Me Out’s mid-song tempo switch is the best-known arrangement move.
whyMatters.zh: 格拉斯哥四人组，2002 年成立。《Franz Ferdinand》（2004，Domino）把棱角后朋吉他与偏迪斯科的贝斯送上英美 indie 榜；《Take Me Out》曲中变速是最知名的编曲手法。

lyricQuotes: I say don't you know / You say you don't know / I say take me out
Do you want to / Come on to me well do you want to

shortBio.en: Glasgow post-punk revival, 2002–. Take Me Out is the tempo-switch single; McCarthy era defines the first decade.
shortBio.zh: 格拉斯哥后朋复兴，2002 年至今。《Take Me Out》是变速单曲；McCarthy 时期定义第一个十年。

body.en:
Franz Ferdinand formed in Glasgow in 2002. Debut Franz Ferdinand (2004) and You Could Have It So Much Better (2005) pair Kapranos’s dry vocal with McCarthy’s choppy rhythm guitar, Hardy’s melodic bass, and Thomson’s tight hi-hat work.

Take Me Out (2004) splits verse and chorus tempos on purpose—danceable post-punk at single length. They share the 2000s revival map with Interpol and The Strokes but lean more on movement and disco bass figures. McCarthy left in 2017.
body.zh:
Franz Ferdinand 于 2002 年在格拉斯哥成立。首专《Franz Ferdinand》（2004）与《You Could Have It So Much Better》（2005）把 Kapranos 干人声、McCarthy 碎节奏吉他、Hardy 旋律贝斯与 Thomson 紧 hi-hat 合在一起。

《Take Me Out》（2004）故意拆开主副歌速度——单曲长度的可跳舞后朋。与 Interpol、The Strokes 同在 2000 年代复兴地图，但更偏律动与迪斯科贝斯型。McCarthy 于 2017 年离队。

note.en: Verse at half tempo, chorus at full speed; dance-punk arrangement as the main hook.
note.zh: 主歌半速、副歌全速；dance-punk 编曲即主要钩子。

note.en: From You Could Have It So Much Better; staccato guitar stabs, four-on-the-floor kick.
note.zh: 出自《You Could Have It So Much Better》；断奏吉他刺击、四拍底鼓。

note.en: From Darts of Pleasure EP; tight rhythm section before debut-album polish.
note.zh: 出自 Darts of Pleasure EP；首专抛光前的紧节奏组。

title.zh: 格拉斯哥 dance-punk 上 indie 榜

body.en:
Franz Ferdinand wrote short songs with dry production and rhythm guitar as a lead voice. Debut Franz Ferdinand (2004, Domino) landed during the Strokes/Interpol wave and added disco bass figures and tempo tricks.

Take Me Out’s half-time verse into full-speed chorus is the most-cited arrangement move. Kapranos’s conversational vocal kept the singles readable on radio.
body.zh:
Franz Ferdinand 写短歌、干制作，并以节奏吉他作主要声部。首专《Franz Ferdinand》（2004，Domino）落在 Strokes/Interpol 浪潮中，并加上迪斯科贝斯型与变速。

《Take Me Out》半速主歌接全速副歌是最常被引用的编曲动作。Kapranos 对话式人声让单曲在电台上易读。

body.en:
2002–2017 core: Kapranos, McCarthy, Hardy, Thomson—no second singer; McCarthy covered guitar and keys.

You Could Have It So Much Better (2005) kept the same approach with larger choruses. Right Thoughts, Right Words, Right Action (2013) added some new-wave synth touches with the same four names on stage.

McCarthy’s 2017 exit ended the first decade’s guitar voicing.
body.zh:
2002–2017 核心：Kapranos、McCarthy、Hardy、Thomson——无双主唱；McCarthy 兼吉他与键盘。

《You Could Have It So Much Better》（2005）保持同一写法并加大副歌。《Right Thoughts, Right Words, Right Action》（2013）加入部分新 wave 合成器点缀，台上仍四人名。

McCarthy 2017 年离队结束第一个十年的吉他声部。

title.en: UK post-punk revival and chart peers
title.zh: 英国后朋复兴与榜单同辈

body.en:
The 2004–05 chart run showed UK post-punk revival could sell outside NYC, with Talking Heads and Joy Division echoes plus dance-floor tempo.

Later indie acts cite Take Me Out’s tempo switch and Hardy’s melodic bass. Arctic Monkeys’ early UK rise shared Domino/indie-chart timing.

The lasting references are structural: tempo, bass, dry vocal.
body.zh:
2004–05 的榜单表现说明英国后朋复兴可在纽约之外卖出，带 Talking Heads、Joy Division 回声与舞池速度。

后期 indie 常引用《Take Me Out》变速与 Hardy 旋律贝斯。Arctic Monkeys 早期英国上升与 Domino/indie 榜时机重合。

持久参照在结构：速度、贝斯、干人声。

body.en: Verse at half tempo, chorus at full sprint. The tempo change is the hook as much as the riff.
body.zh: 主歌半速、副歌全速。变速与 riff 同为钩子。

body.en: Staccato guitar stabs and four-on-the-floor kick from the second album’s radio cycle.
body.zh: 二专电台周期中的断奏吉他刺击与四拍底鼓。

body.en: Early Darts of Pleasure EP cut with a tight rhythm section before debut-album polish.
body.zh: 早期 Darts of Pleasure EP 曲，首专抛光前的紧节奏组。

interviewQuotes.text: We wanted songs girls could dance to—and boys could play.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Alex Kapranos

interviewQuotes.text: The angular riff is the hook. Everything else is arrangement.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Nick McCarthy

note.en: McCarthy era; danceable post-punk singles on Domino.
note.zh: McCarthy 时期；Domino 上可跳舞的后朋单曲。

note.en: Mid-song tempo drop as dance-floor indie citation.
note.zh: 曲中降速，舞池 indie 引用点。

note.en: Post-punk revival with disco bass figures; Glasgow art-school four-piece.
note.zh: 带迪斯科贝斯型的后朋克复兴；格拉斯哥艺术学校四人组。
